description.value: The Fog Alarm Building is a historic structure within Gulf Islands National Park Reserve, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a museum, reflecting its role in interpreting the maritime and navigational heritage of the southern Gulf Islands. The park reserve spans multiple islands and is accessible by ferry, making it a distinctive destination for cycle-touring visitors exploring the archipelago. Parks Canada operates interpretive programs throughout the reserve, though details specific to this building are not available from the associated web content.
